# unifi_setting_ntp (Resource)

Manage the NTP servers a site's UniFi devices use, the legacy local Network API setting `ntp`. The setting exists once per site: the resource takes over the existing document, or creates it on a site that has never saved it, and changes only the mode and the servers. Each write sends the document back whole, to preserve the fields it doesn't model, so a field that was absent can become empty but never absent again. Import with `<site_id>`. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

# Let the devices use a local time server first, then a public pool.
resource "unifi_setting_ntp" "default" {
  site_id = data.unifi_site.default.id
  mode    = "manual"
  servers = ["192.0.2.1", "pool.ntp.org"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `auto` uses Ubiquiti's NTP pool; `manual` uses `servers`.
- `site_id` (String) Integration site UUID.

### Optional

- `servers` (List of String) Up to four NTP servers (host names or IP addresses), in order. Required for `mode = "manual"`. With `auto` the controller keeps them but doesn't use them. Keeps the controller's value when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic resource ID equal to `site_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The setting exists once per site: import with the integration site UUID.
terraform import unifi_setting_ntp.default <site_id>
```
